meta.title: Rewards World™ | Total rewards and pay governance
meta.description: Rewards World™ helps HR, finance and boards in India design, run and explain pay. Eight connected services, from a free first look to board-ready packs.

hero.title: Pay that people trust, and a board can defend
hero.lead: Rewards World™ helps HR, finance and boards in India design, run and explain pay. One connected journey takes you from a free first look to board-ready packs, with every deliverable reviewed by a second person before it goes out.

trust.title: Held in India, ready to show
trust.lead: Your data stays in India. The work is set up so you can show what was decided, by whom, and from which source.
items: Data in India
The tool and your data are hosted in India.
A named second pair of eyes
Every review is approved by a different named person, and every decision is recorded.
Sources on the page
Rules and limits carry their source and date. Anything not yet checked by a legal adviser is clearly marked draft.
Change it yourselves
Words, rules and access can be updated by your own team, without waiting for a developer.

problems.title: The everyday problems we help with
items: Spreadsheets everywhere
Pay data lives in many files and versions. We load it once, check it, and use it for every piece of work.
Typing the same data again
Each service hands its data and results to the next, so nothing is keyed in twice.
Unclear approvals
Every review is approved by a different named person, and every decision is recorded.
Board packs that take weeks
Packs are built from the checked data, with sources, assumptions and risks on one page.
Keeping up with the rules
Rules and limits carry their source and date. Anything not yet checked by a legal adviser is clearly marked draft.
Juniors who cannot explain the numbers
Plain explanations on every screen, and a short check of understanding before a pack goes to the board.

journey.title: Eight services, one connected journey
journey.lead: Start anywhere that suits you. Each service builds on the last, so your data is loaded once and every result carries forward.

services.name: Diagnostic
services.what: A free first look at how well pay is run, with your Governance Quotient™ score and the three things to fix first.

services.name: Health Check
services.what: Where pay stands today: cost, fairness, position against ranges and the gaps, using your own data.

services.name: Salary Band Build
services.what: Fair, affordable salary bands for every grade, with the cost of moving people into them.

services.name: Full Architecture Pack
services.what: The whole pay system designed together: grades, pay rises, bonus and approvals, with a board pack.

services.name: ESOP and LTI
services.what: Share awards that reward long-term success, with their cost now, later and in a bad year.

services.name: NRC Paper Review
services.what: A clear paper on executive pay that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee can decide on.

services.name: Governance Retainer
services.what: A monthly look at pay decisions, so problems are caught early and oversight is on record.

services.name: Extra Work
services.what: Anything outside the written scope, agreed with you in writing before it starts.

how.title: How working with us feels
steps: Create a free account and answer the governance questions. You keep your score.
Simple Excel templates explain every column. We check the files before any number is used.
See the work as it happens
Each service follows the same five steps: get data, check, build, review, deliver.
Excel, PowerPoint and print versions, each with a version stamp and the name of who approved it.

learning.title: Learn the work as you do it
learning.lead: Plain explanations sit on every screen, so someone new to pay and a board director can both follow the same work. A short check of understanding is completed before a pack goes to the board.
levels: A school student or fresher can follow the steps, with every term explained in everyday words.
Associates, managers and specialists build the files, with the reason for each choice written next to it.
A CHRO, CFO, CXO or KMP can review the same numbers and the questions a committee is likely to ask.
Packs are written so a director can follow the sources, assumptions and risks without a separate briefing.
